about: How the Spec Kit requirements (specs/001-006) group into OpenSpec capabilities. scripts/openspec.js generates openspec/specs/<capability>/spec.md from this map; Spec Kit stays the source of truth for these requirements. Keys are REQ ids, or spec:REQ where an id appears in two specs (the REQ-032..035 collision between 002 and 003 is still open).

feed.title: Feed
feed.purpose: The superintelligence feed itself: which stories appear, how duplicates group, how they are tagged, filtered, searched and laid out on a laptop and a phone.

sources.title: Sources and harvesting
sources.purpose: Where stories come from: scheduled harvesting from public sources, the refusal of Twitter/X, resilience to a failing source, source labels, paper metadata and the daily paper watch.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.purpose: Signing up, signing in and out, how passwords are kept, and the limit on personal data the site collects.

votes-and-saves.title: Votes and saves
votes-and-saves.purpose: What a signed-in reader can do with a story: vote, save, export their own data, within per-user ownership rules and vote limits.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.purpose: How the site and its content reach people: the public URL, feeds, an installable app and published editorial posts.

governance.title: Governance
governance.purpose: How the two partners keep the project honest: the human-written agent log, the project tracker and the public change log of rules.

learn.title: Learn and studio
learn.purpose: Plain-language explanations of the ideas behind superintelligence research, the walk-through page, dependent forms and the background studio jobs that make explainers.

lab.title: Lab
lab.purpose: Worked examples with deterministic toy reproductions and hypotheses of our own, and the fixed benchmarks every judge and toy is measured on.

review-desk.title: Review desk
review-desk.purpose: Judging papers, articles and comments with explainable, guarded judges: canonical text, evidence markers, kinds, verdict bands, source grades, two-model panels, peer reviews, comment roles and topic dossiers.

appearance-and-publishing.title: Appearance and publishing
appearance-and-publishing.purpose: How the extended site looks and how editors start posts from the site's own data, with channel versions that are never posted automatically.

paper-responses.title: Paper responses
paper-responses.purpose: Reading a paper in full, analysing it against its own body, planning a response and drafting a narrated explainer, an article and posts, chosen and checked by stated models, behind a feature flag.

inChanges.about: Requirements planned in an open OpenSpec change. Their capability specs come from the change's spec deltas when it is archived (openspec archive), so they aren't generated here.
